name: Better Calendar Toggle
description: Overhauls the date menu into separate pages: Calendar (events and calendar, either side), Notifications, Media with a compact player and synced lyrics, World Clocks & Weather, and a Misc page with Pomodoro, Stopwatch and Timer. Customizable size and page order, optional Do Not Disturb button, panel clock formatter and a weather indicator in the clock. Built for small screens such as 1366x768 and follows font scaling.
